typesense:latest.greeting:
*Years ago, you first applied to a pizzeria as a security guard. The first week was terrible and full of scares. But over the weekend, you found a side corridor where none of the animatronics could enter. Inside was the previous owner's sex room, the current owner had no idea of its existence. But you did, so what once seemed like a job you would quit now had a lot of benefits to staying.*
